readme:
## Anthropic LLM Backend

The built-in Anthropic Messages API backend (Claude). Ships with every MailFlow install alongside the OpenAI-compatible backend.

### Usage

```toml
[[llms]]
llm_id = "claude"
provider = "anthropic"
model = "claude-3-5-sonnet-latest"
api_key = "${ANTHROPIC_API_KEY}"
```

The system prompt travels in the Anthropic `system` field and the remaining messages keep their roles; retries use bounded backoff and error text is sanitized so URLs or keys never leak.

MIT — contributions welcome.

## mailflow-llm-anthropic

内置 Anthropic Messages API 后端（Claude）。随每个 MailFlow 安装自带，与 OpenAI 兼容后端并列。

### 使用

```toml
[[llms]]
llm_id = "claude"
provider = "anthropic"
model = "claude-3-5-sonnet-latest"
api_key = "${ANTHROPIC_API_KEY}"
```

系统提示词放入 Anthropic `system` 字段，其余消息保留角色；重试使用有界退避，错误文本经过消毒，URL 与密钥不会泄漏。

### 协议

MIT — 欢迎贡献。
